I dragged my heavy feet.

Toward some refuge.
Preferably a place with nothing in it.

A voice behind me.
Not a sound of restraint.

…Ah.
Everything receded.

Just as I had wished.

Contempt in his voice.
Hearing it, I thought—

Never.
Not in my dreams had I imagined
this man could be such… a kind person.
